title: Parliament opens debate on key national reforms
author: Alfred G. Ondieki
summary: Lawmakers began discussions on governance and finance reforms.
body:
NAIROBI — Parliament today opened debate on a series of reforms affecting governance and public finance.

Members of Parliament discussed proposals touching on budget accountability and service delivery.

More details will follow as the debate continues.
